title: Spicy Taco Rye Burgers
description: A flavorful twist on traditional burgers with spicy taco seasoning and crunchy rye buns. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef and taco seasoning.
3. Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
4. Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
5. Meanwhile, toast the rye buns on the grill or in a toaster.
6. Assemble the burgers with lettuce, tomatoes, red onion, avocado, and shredded cheese.
7. Serve with spicy sauce on the side, if desired.
8. Cook the buns for an additional 2-3 minutes to give them a nice crunch.
9. Serve the burgers on the toasted rye buns.
10. Enjoy your delicious Spicy Taco Rye Burgers!
